note: Used by the site's search. Each group is a set of terms that should find each other; a group member of several words applies only when it is the whole search. exact lists words that must match as typed, never as the start of a longer word, because the longer words mean something else ("java" and "javascript"). Symbol words are written as search reads them: "csharp" for C#, "dotnet" for .NET, "cplusplus" for C++.
